    // the new bounds. Cell size follows the new extent, so this stretches rather
    // than re-tiles.
    ConformedTo(self: StrutLattice3D, bounds: Bounds3D): StrutLattice3D
        => StrutLattice3D(self.Cell, bounds, self.Counts, self.Radius);
